hook: why you genuinely cannot tell whether a supplement is working
caption: Five reasons, and four of them are things you did without noticing.
notes: The methodology post for the stack lane. Save rate should be high on this one.

slides.text: why you genuinely cannot tell whether a supplement is working
slides.sub: (four mistakes. i have made all four of them)

slides.text: Three at once tells you nothing about any of them.
You started when you felt worst.
slides.sub: You were going to feel better anyway. That's regression, not the pill.

slides.text: Without a baseline there's nothing to compare to.
slides.sub: Seven days of doing nothing is the most boring and most important week.

slides.text: And “I feel sharper” is not a measurement.
slides.sub: Pick a number you don't control. Deep sleep. Resting heart rate.

slides.text: One thing. Two weeks. One number.
slides.sub: It's genuinely that simple, it's just annoying to keep track of. That's the part I let Ren do. It's in my bio.
